career_overview.short_description: Study people’s goals and difficulties, then design and test better experiences. Start with a small problem you can investigate ethically.
responsibilities: Assess goals and constraints relevant to ux designer work
Apply appropriate tools and methods to a bounded task
representative_work: A researched, tested user-flow prototype and concise case study.

roadmap.title: UX Designer: beginner foundations and starter project
roadmap.intended_learner: Motivated beginner; basic computer literacy assumed, with no prior professional experience.
roadmap.starting_requirements: Computer, internet access, text editor and browser. Most tasks use free software or simulation; specialist equipment, accounts and costs are flagged for review when applicable.
roadmap.final_outcome: A researched, tested user-flow prototype and concise case study.
